title: Canonical ampleness of compact hyperbolic Kähler manifolds

abstractEnglish: We prove that every compact connected Kähler manifold of positive complex dimension containing no nonconstant entire curve has ample canonical bundle and is projective. This resolves positively Kobayashi's canonical-ampleness conjecture in the smooth compact Kähler category.
